instruction: Alaminos City Tourism Guide: profile, entry 1
response: {"city": "Alaminos City", "source_file": "Alaminos_City_Tourism_Guide.pdf", "source_sha256": "fb5a36db5d21bae07b4fa28e117d6d1a4e5588b9a0854ea68d2ebd35b572fc64", "source_url": "https://www.alaminoscity.gov.ph/public-service/programs-and-projects/tourism/", "source_date": "2026-09", "operating_details_verified": false, "field": "profile", "value": "Alaminos City is the home and main gateway of Hundred Islands National Park. The city combines island-hopping, coastal recreation, city-center heritage, local food, and a growing hospitality sector. The official city government describes Hundred Islands National Park as a major tourism asset and provides a Tourism Information Center at Plaza Enrique Braganza. For visitors, Lucap is the key area because Lucap Wharf is the departure point for Hundred Islands. Poblacion provides access to the city center, while coastal areas such as Bolo and Telbang offer beach and resort options."}
